topic: 专项突破：现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析与综合运用 (Present Perfect vs. Past Simple)

questions.question: Emma ______ her keys on the playground yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句中有明确的过去时间状语 'yesterday afternoon'，表示动作发生在过去，应用一般过去时，动词 lose 的过去式为 lost。

questions.question: I can't go to the park now because I ______ my homework yet.
questions.explanation: 句末的 'yet' 常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句中，主语为 'I'，因此使用 haven't finished。

questions.question:
— Where is Mrs. Green? 
— She ______ to London for a business conference. She will return next week.
questions.explanation: 根据后文 'She will return next week' 可知，格林夫人去了伦敦且尚未回来，应用 'have/has gone to'；主语是第三人称单数，故选 has gone。

questions.question: Oliver has lived in this modern apartment ______ 2021.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时中，表示“自从某一具体时间点起”用介词 since。2021 是具体时间点，故选 since。

questions.question: The students ______ a lot of trees around the campus two days ago.
questions.explanation: 'two days ago' 是明确的过去时间点，强调动作在过去发生并结束，谓语动词需用一般过去时 planted。

questions.question:
— ______ you ever ______ authentic Italian pizza? 
— No, never.
questions.explanation: 'ever' 意为“曾经”，常用于现在完成时询问人生经历，其结构为 'Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词'，eat 的过去分词是 eaten。

questions.question: My elder sister ______ the violin since she was six years old.
questions.explanation: 'since + 过去时间状语从句' 引导的时间状语通常与现在完成时连用，表示动作从过去持续到现在，故用 has played。

questions.question: We ______ Beijing twice. It is a truly fascinating city.
questions.explanation: 'have been to' 表示“曾经去过某地（现在已回来）”，常与次数连用；'have gone to' 表示“去了某地尚未回来”。根据语境应用 have been to。

questions.question: Listen! The bell is ringing. The morning class ______.
questions.explanation: 'just' 常用于现在完成时，位于助动词 have/has 与过去分词之间，强调刚刚发生的动作对现在产生的影响。

questions.question: When ______ you ______ that beautiful robotic model?
questions.explanation: 以 when 引导的特殊疑问句询问具体动作发生的时间，不能用现在完成时，而要用一般过去时。助动词 did 之后接动词原形 buy。

questions.question: Look at the tidy bedroom! Liam ______ all his toys.
questions.explanation: 由 'Look at the tidy bedroom!' 可知，房间整洁是过去动作产生的结果，'already' 用于肯定句中，用现在完成时 has already packed。

questions.question: They ______ their grandparents last weekend because of the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 'last weekend' 表示过去的时间，一般过去时的否定句结构为 'didn't + 动词原形'，故选 didn't visit。

questions.question: Mr. Harrison has worked in this international primary school ______ eight years.
questions.explanation: 'eight years' 是一段持续的时间，现在完成时中接时间段用介词 for；接具体时间起点才用 since。

questions.question:
— Have you read the novel *Harry Potter*? 
— Yes, I ______ it during the summer holiday.
questions.explanation: 答语中提到了具体的过去时间 'during the summer holiday'，表示该动作发生在特定的过去时间，应转用一般过去时。read 的过去式拼写仍为 read（发音为 /red/）。

questions.question: Be careful! Someone ______ water on the floor, and it is slippery.
questions.explanation: 地滑（it is slippery）是过去洒水动作对现在造成的影响和残留结果，强调对现况的影响，用现在完成时 has spilled。

questions.question: My grandfather ______ this wooden house with his own hands in 1988.
questions.explanation: 'in 1988' 是确定的过去年份，句意陈述过去发生的一件事实，应用一般过去时 built。

questions.question: So far this term, our robotics team ______ three regional competitions.
questions.explanation: 'so far' 意为“到目前为止”，是现在完成时的标志性时间状语；团队主语视作单数整体，故用 has won。

questions.question:
— Did you enjoy the magic show last night? 
— Yes, it ______ absolutely wonderful!
questions.explanation: 问句针对昨晚（last night）提问，描述过去的体验和感受用一般过去时。主语 it 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 was。

questions.question: I can't unlock the front door because I ______ my key.
questions.explanation: 现在进不去门是因为钥匙“已经丢了”，钥匙丢了的状态直接影响到现在，强调对现在的影响，应用现在完成时 have lost。

questions.question: Sophia ______ to the science museum many times, so she knows the route well.
questions.explanation: 'many times' 表示经历过多次且目前熟悉路线，说明人已经去过并返回，故用 has been (to)。

questions.question: The Wright brothers ______ the first successful motor-operated airplane in 1903.
questions.explanation: 历史事实且带有明确的过去年份 'in 1903'，谓语动词必须使用一般过去时 invented。

questions.question: Lucas isn't hungry at all. He ______ lunch with his teammates.
questions.explanation: 主语 Lucas 为第三人称单数，表示刚刚吃过午餐对现在产生的影响（不饿），应使用 has just had。

questions.question: How long ______ you ______ each other before joining this club?
questions.explanation: 以 'How long' 提问动作持续的时长，谓语动词 know 是延续性含义的用法，询问认识多久通常用现在完成时 'have you known'。

questions.question: We ______ a lot of wildlife photographs when we were camping in Kenya.
questions.explanation: 时间状语从句 'when we were camping...' 明确指向过去在肯尼亚露营的那段特定时间，主句叙述过去的动作应用一般过去时 took。

questions.question:
— Have you submitted your English project ______? 
— Not yet, Miss Davis.
questions.explanation: yet 常用于现在完成时的疑问句句末，表示“已经”；答语中的 'Not yet' 也是明确的提示。

questions.question: The glass window is broken. Who ______ it?
questions.explanation: 窗户现在碎了（is broken），询问是谁造成了现在的后果，动作发生时间不确定，侧重对现在状态的追溯，用 has broken。

questions.question: Mia ______ her ankle while she was skipping rope ten minutes ago.
questions.explanation: 'ten minutes ago' 属于过去的时间点，表示扭伤发生在十分钟前，应用一般过去时 twisted。

questions.question: Jack ______ in five different countries since his family started travelling.
questions.explanation: 由 since 引导的从句（从过去开始旅行起）修饰主句，主句表示持续到现在的居住经历，应用现在完成时 has lived。

questions.question:
— I can't find Tom anywhere. 
— He ______ to the library to return some storybooks.
questions.explanation: 由 'I can't find Tom anywhere' 可知汤姆此时不在这里，他“去了图书馆还没回来”，表示“去了某地未归”应用 has gone to。

questions.question:
— ______ you ______ the solar eclipse this morning? 
— Yes, I saw it through special dark glasses.
questions.explanation: 根据答句中的过去式 saw 以及问句中特定的时间 'this morning'（说话时该时段通常已过去），问句应当用一般过去时 Did you watch。
